title: On a scheme with affine diagonal covered by n+1 affine opens the restriction of an injective torsion module has no cohomology above degree n
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the cohomological dimension of a closed subscheme with affine-module coefficients: for X with affine diagonal covered by n+1 affine opens, H^q_etale(Z, I|_Z) = 0 for q > n (statement lines 15258-15266). The proof (proof lines 15268-15306) proves the affine case by passing to the henselisation of the pair, invoking the henselian-pair comparison, and evaluating the resulting filtered colimit through injectivity of the restriction along etale morphisms; the general case follows by induction using Mayer-Vietoris for a cover by a union of n affine opens and one affine open, with affineness of the diagonal controlling the intersection. H2: one affine computation plus an induction on the number of affine opens.
